title: Medical Event Record
sub: A record of each medical event at school or on school time that needed more than routine care: something swallowed, a seizure that was long or intense, a serious injury, an allergic reaction, choking or trouble breathing, or an illness that ended in an emergency room. What happened and who responded, the nurse, 911 and the emergency room, what the doctor said and the discharge instructions, who was told and when, the return to school, the follow-up, and the photos and discharge papers attached. It sits beside Form DM-1 (the safety precautions and the health record), Form IM-1 (injuries from self-injury), Form CR-1 (the crisis plan) and Form MS-1 (medication side effects). It does not replace the school’s or agency’s own incident report or the nurse’s record.
